## What You Will Learn

Master the transformer architecture — the foundation of every modern LLM.

### Easy
1. **Scaled Dot-Product Attention** — The core attention mechanism
2. **Multi-Head Attention** — Parallel attention with different projections
3. **Positional Encoding** — Adding word order with sine/cosine waves

### Medium
4. **Encoder Block** — Self-attention + FFN + residuals + layer norm
5. **Decoder Block** — Masked attention + cross-attention + FFN
6. **Full Transformer Model** — Stack encoders and decoders end-to-end
7. **Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE)** — Subword tokenization algorithm

### Hard
8. **Masked Language Modeling** — BERT pretraining with 80-10-10 masking
9. **Autoregressive Generation** — GPT-style text generation with temperature
10. **Fine-Tuning Pipeline** — Adapt pretrained models to downstream tasks
